policy.author: Tund

environment.commandDelivery: Direct commands on the policy control clock, shared by manual and benchmark modes.

actuation.motor_parameters: Preserve exported per-joint gains, armature, torque-speed curves, action scaling, offsets and target clipping.
actuation.nominal_choice: Use floor midpoint of historical physical-step delay range and midpoint of the independent motor bus delay.

limitations: This is the replacement upright/tiny-step checkpoint, not the earlier generic turn export; candidate source commit is five seconds before run start, but no checkpoint Git SHA is embedded.
Nominal deterministic reconstruction: training domain randomization, observation noise and stochastic latency are disabled; this does not establish hardware or exact training-rollout equivalence.
W&B checkpoint evidence: No tracked changes were logged; untracked files were gallery outputs. A matched checkpoint and logged settings do not establish GPU-training or hardware rollout equivalence.

observations.notes: Preserve training order: buffered derived gyro/gravity before forward, fresh joint positions/velocities. Choose zero extra sensor lag and no noise for a repeatable nominal profile.

evidence.summary:
Gallery: replace the turn policy with the upright tiny-step fine-tune

Resumed from the mid-tilt step run with the tilt penalty at -5 and swing
paid 4x under commands within SMALL_MOVE_LIMITS. It now steps under 0.15 m/s
sidesteps and 0.3 rad/s spot turns, and passes the gallery replica on every
key with no falls.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
This is the replacement upright/tiny-step checkpoint, not the earlier generic turn export; candidate source commit is five seconds before run start, but no checkpoint Git SHA is embedded.
Exact actor and normalization match; logged configuration and reached curriculum checked.

provenance.training_engine: Logged run requirements: MuJoCo 3.11.1.dev965888812; mujoco-warp 3.11.0; mjlab 1.6.0. Native CPU checks use that MuJoCo distribution; the browser uses WASM 3.11.0.

curriculum_evidence.source_rule: Recovered source removes command_range curriculum for these variants; use logged fixed action ranges.

wandb.source_tree_note: No tracked changes were logged; untracked files were gallery outputs.

validation.scope: Short nominal browser/native physics regression with identical applied controls; browser 3.11.0 versus native 3.11.1. Does not verify original checkpoint provenance, randomized training, or hardware performance.

policy.title: AMP legs - upright, steps on tiny commands, spot turns + sidesteps (9k it)

protocol.ceilingNote: Highest sustained tested value, not a proven physical maximum. Passing the ceiling is explicitly reported.
protocol.commandDelivery: Trace command is the delivered policy input; requestedCommand is the high-level request. If the adapter omits deliveredCommand, direct delivery is assumed. Sender ramps are part of the evaluated contract, not silently removed.
protocol.commandLimitSource: Logged training configuration and curriculum at the exported checkpoint
protocol.commandRangeNote: Every phase is checked against all supplied axis limits and any planar cap. Commands are never clamped. Use logged checkpoint curriculum limits when available, otherwise exported declarations; the scorecard records which source was used. Missing or malformed limits remain unverified.

fallDetector.note: Shared K1 benchmark detector; not a reconstruction of training terminations.

protocol.repeatsNote: Capacity/envelope points require every repetition to pass. A full leaderboard entry requires at least two repetitions.

scoring.comparabilityNote: A smaller declared command envelope can yield a high conditional dependability score on fewer or easier probes. Scores alone do not establish equal capability across envelopes.
scoring.dependabilityNormalization: Per-kind means use only included attempts, with fixed weights and no renormalization. If any required kind has no completed within-range measurement, dependability is null. Always compare scores alongside coverage and declared limits.
scoring.dependabilityScope: Only completed within-declared-command-range standstill, tracking, braking, and recovery attempts contribute. Stress and unverified attempts are excluded, not scored as failures.

protocol.stopNote: The high-level zero request starts the braking window after an attained and sustained approach. Distance/time include sender ramp travel. Settling requires delivered zero and raw velocity limits continuously throughout the final hold.

trackingFilter.movingCommands: Filtered velocity errors against delivered policy commands determine moving tracking. Capacity, mixed movement, and approach attainment additionally require tracking the requested target.
trackingFilter.reset: Seed from measured initial velocity only at attempt reset; retain across phase and command changes.
trackingFilter.zeroCommands: Raw errors determine standstill, standing recovery, and braking hold. Position-based distance/drift and fall detection are always raw.

protocol.turningNote: Smallest passing tested nominal radius at each shared speed; measured radius comes from speed/yaw and is not a proven physical minimum.
